text:
sarah_sales: FYI Novarro POC asked for SOC 2 artifacts + a signed pen-test letter, they want both by EOD Friday. Also asked: what's the delta if we run this on Dedicated EU vs hosted (data residency + pricing).
jason_se: Ack. Do we have a standard pen-test letter template we can sign and hand off? If not, who owns redlines? @emma_security?
emma_security: We have a pen-test attestation template in the compliance repo. I can sign the standard one for POCs but legal sometimes wants to add wording for 'no warranty'. Send over the customer name and intended environment (prod-like or staging).
sarah_sales: Customer = Novarro Inc, POC will hit staging but they require EU residency for logs. They also asked about a dedicated pool for predictable throughput.
marco_devops: For EU residency we'd need Dedicated (or Private). Hosted API currently stores logs in multi-region with controls but not single-tenant EU-only. Dedicated pricing: add ~€8k/mo for a small reserved pool + data transfer. I'll paste a quick estimate: `dedicated-min: €8k/mo, burst buffer +€2k/mo, setup one-off €3k`.
jason_se: Can you attach the SOC 2 excerpt we normally share? Prefer redacted controls list + scope PDF.
emma_security: Uploaded the SOC2-excerpt (redacted) to the secure folder and generated a presigned link. Also attached the pen-test attestation draft we use for POCs.
legal-bot: file uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/compliance/SOC2_excerpt_redacted.pdf (expires in 7 days)
marco_devops: FYI if they want logs retained in EU for 90 days only, we can do that on Dedicated with KMS keys in eu-west-1. That avoids Private deployment. KMS setup takes ~2 business days.
sarah_sales: Novarro also asked whether we can supply an external scan report vs full internal pentest. They said external blackbox is fine for procurement. Is that acceptable?
emma_security: External scan + pen-test letter is usually fine for POC. For enterprise procurement we'll escalate to a full red-team later. I'll prepare an external-scan attestation and add the standard clause about scope and signatory.
jason_se: Great. Can you confirm timeline? Customer deadline EOD Friday — that's 3 business days. Any blockers?
emma_security: Timeline tight but doable for SOC excerpt + pen-test attestation. Need sales to confirm signing email and the contact for the legal signatory and the presigned S3 acceptance. Also need approval for sending any network diagrams.
sarah_sales: I'll confirm contact info now. Contact: legal@novarro.com (Anya Petrov), procurement@novarro.com. No internal network diagrams requested for POC, just attestation + excerpt.
marco_devops: I'll queue the Dedicated cost approval. If they sign a month commit we can drop setup fee by 50%. Tell them to confirm commitment window.
jason_se: I'll update the quote with the Dedicated line item + EU KMS option and note the pen-test attestation included. Will ping procurement thread.
emma_security: Drafts will be in the same folder. If legal wants changes, please route to me + legal@redwood.com; minor redlines okay, major scope changes require exec review.
sarah_sales: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll close the loop with Novarro and post back once they confirm the commit term. :thumbsup:
